payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the crowdsourcing scheme used to instruct workers on identifying important elements in document collections.

claims.text: Crowd workers were instructed using a new crowdsourcing scheme called low-context importance annotation, which allows them to determine important elements without reading all documents.
This approach enables efficient and scalable annotation of important elements in document clusters, overcoming quality issues from traditional methods.
The scheme produces reliable data for focused summarization scenarios, similar to earlier annotation efforts.
